newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 489 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 489 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totaled 489 contracts versus 550 contracts traded overnight Sunday.
There were 40 wheat, 324 corn, 98 soybean, 22 soyoil, three oat, one corn call and one corn put.
In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 cent lower, corn was one to 1-1/4 cents lower, soybeans 1/2 cent higher to 1/2 lower and soyoil was 0.02 cent per lb higher.
